LanguageData.Rimverse_PsyNeedSpace: Only works aboard a ship or on a world of the Rimverse map.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PsyNoneLost: No colonist is lost in the backrooms.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PsyRecalled: {0} was pulled back from the backrooms.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterVoiceRadio: Through the static, a voice calls the crew by name. Nobody knows where the signal comes from, and it fades before it can be traced. Something heard the ship, and it is coming.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgUnlistedCrewmate: Someone aboard is not on the crew list.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterYellowSignal: A distress call arrived with coordinates that do not exist in the catalog. {0} went to check the signal in a ship corridor and never came back. The floor there smells of damp carpet.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterRoomsSurvivor: {0} appeared in a ship corridor, thin, frightened and carrying loot. They say they came from yellow rooms that never end, and want to stay.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgOfficeEcho: {0} keeps hearing lights that are not there.
